request: REV-COMB-3 R3-01; LEAD CHANGELOG line 194 (3): release hold as a function of the post-E2 command profile over all PURGE NOT RUN records + one 10 ms frame; per-record classes for GNC

definitions.release: first release opportunity E2 + max(H, 10 ms); release term Pc >= 3.0 bar abs (E2 in the latency model is Pc > 3 bar abs held 10 ms, so the term is true at E2 until a gap arrives)
definitions.optimistic: released then A3 iff the gap arrives at or after the release
definitions.conservative: released then A3 iff the A3 trip (gap arrival + 22 ms) comes after the release
definitions.A3_before_release: P_A3_trip - P_released_then_A3 (abort with the drogue attached)
definitions.success: light and no gap lasting >= 22 ms; independent of H
definitions.hold_needed: latest A3 trip over the records of the group (max of MC and deterministic supremum) + 10 ms, rounded up to 10 ms
definitions.worst_convention: per record the paused/restart convention with the lower P_success (the trip classes are identical in both)

notes: R3-12: in the latency model E2 is Pc > 3 bar abs held 10 ms; the firmware E2 is the relative rule. At the 0.2039 mm start lift the lit plateau is 2.66-3.11 bar abs, so with the command held at the start level the Pc >= 3.0 bar term can be false and the release waits for the b7 term (E2 + 0.10 s): read the H = 0.10 s row for those corners. This moves probability from released-then-A3 to A3-before-release; P(success) is unchanged.

R3-12: lift basis: PURGE s/cm3 is the 0.2039 mm value; t_lift (29.6 ms) and the confirmation-time pool come from the 0.2192 mm runs (t_lift at 0.2039 mm is 28.7 ms). Not re-run; the hold values move by < 1 ms of t_lift.

The hold adds no success: it moves released-then-A3 to A3-before-release. Any P gain must come from records that light without a gap trip; the cost of the longer hold is GNC's (REPORT §7.3: GNC found a 0.4 s hold costs P).

tags.classes: SIM on ASSUMED delays (rg01 set reproduced) + DERIVED line states (records not re-run); post-light timing DERIVED approximation (parent); A3 rule per REPORT v2.4 7.4; lights during vapour not modelled
tags.population: bracket records, NOT probability-weighted; means are unweighted over records
